subject: english
question: According to the passage, which activity helps villagers earn income?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Handicrafts"** means items made skillfully by hand, often reflecting cultural or traditional artistry. (हस्तशिल्प)

 
 
• **Example:** The villagers sold beautifully woven baskets as handicrafts to tourists.
 
 
 
• **"Sustainable products"** refers to goods that are created using resources in a way that does not harm the environment and can be maintained over time. (सतत उत्पाद)
 
 
• **Example:** Bags made from jute are considered sustainable products because they are biodegradable.
 
 
 
• Hence, villagers earn income by **crafting handicrafts from sustainable products**, which also supports biodiversity conservation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Poaching endangered species** (लुप्तप्राय प्रजातियों का शिकार): The illegal hunting or capturing of wild animals.

 
 
• **Example:** Poaching tigers has caused a drastic decline in their population.
 
 
 
• **Clearing forests for agriculture** (खेती के लिए जंगल साफ करना): Cutting down trees to create farmland.
 
 
• **Example:** Clearing forests for agriculture has led to habitat loss for many animals.
 
 
 
• **Mining minerals** (खनिजों का खनन): Extracting valuable minerals from the earth.
 
 
• **Example:** Mining minerals often causes environmental degradation and deforestation.
